reason: PITX3 promoter methylation was directly quantified by qPCR in a 326-patient HNSCC cohort and validated in TCGA, with hypermethylation independently predicting overall survival.

An EWAS on blood CpG methylation in the NSPHS cohort identified 211 CpGs differentially methylated in individuals with prior myocardial infarction, positioned explicitly as candidate diagnostic/prognostic biomarkers.
HPV16 L1 gene methylation was measured by pyrosequencing in cervical samples from 145 women and evaluated as a predictor of CIN3+ histology, a diagnostic-decision link.
This is a retrospective evaluation of a pediatric asthma clinical practice guideline's effect on albuterol ordering and length of stay, with no epigenetic marker of any kind measured.
Alongside a novel MRI volume marker, MGMT promoter methylation status was directly used to stratify glioblastoma survival in TCGA and institutional cohorts, an eligible marker linked to prognosis.
Individual age-associated CpG sites underlying epigenetic clocks were measured in blood DNAm profiles from the ESTHER cohort and tested for association with life expectancy and mortality.

Phosphorylated H2AX (gamma-H2AX), an eligible histone modification, was assessed in 54 TNBC patients treated with neoadjuvant chemotherapy and linked to pathological complete response, a treatment-selection outcome.

Genome-wide DNA methylation was measured on the Illumina 450K array in maternal and cord blood from 300 Black women with early spontaneous versus full-term births, a case-control design linking methylation to preterm birth risk.

Peripheral blood methylation at 384 CpGs in addiction-related gene promoters was profiled by GoldenGate array in a case-control study of alcohol/nicotine codependence in African and European Americans.
The UroMark bladder-cancer assay, a methylation-based classifier, was developed and validated in urine sediment from an independent 274-patient human cohort, a diagnostic-accuracy design.
This ex vivo colon culture study measured transcriptional response and eQTLs for HDAC3 and ZSWIM4, but no DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin state was directly measured.
This reads as a narrative product evaluation of the Epi proColon 2.0 test synthesizing prior pivotal studies, not a primary dataset generated by this record.
This is a high-throughput chemical screen for Survivin-Borealin inhibitors performed entirely in cultured cells and an in vitro AlphaScreen system, with no human participants or samples.
Bin1 gene hypermethylation was measured in human ESCC tissue and correlated with clinical parameters and shorter survival, alongside separate cell-line and mouse mechanistic experiments.
In addition to gene expression profiling, CpG island methylation at AHCYL2 and MTMR2 was directly assessed in PBMCs from Italian and Swedish cohort participants and linked to long-term NOx exposure.

MGMT promoter methylation was measured by pyrosequencing in 97 high-grade gliomas and shown to correlate with tumor purity, a clinically relevant biomarker used for treatment decisions in glioblastoma.
Promoter methylation of MCAM, ERalpha and ERbeta was measured by QMSP in serum from prostate cancer cases, controls, and HGPIN patients to develop an early-detection biomarker panel.

Although promoter methylation of DTX1 was confirmed in HNSCC cohorts, the study is a mechanistic tumor-suppressor characterization with no stated link to a modifiable exposure or a clinical/public-health decision.

This cross-sectional study of pesticide sprayers used the bacterial hupB gene for molecular detection of Mycobacterium species and measured hematology/liver enzymes, none of which is a human epigenetic marker.
This randomised phase II trial tests CpG-ODN immunotherapy for glioblastoma survival but does not measure any epigenetic marker in participants.
This is a case series of seven FNA cytology diagnoses of endometriosis with no comparison group and no epigenetic marker measured.

This cross-sectional EWAS links CPT1A methylation to plasma adiponectin, a metabolic biomarker, but states no modifiable exposure/intervention or clinical/public-health decision tied to the association.

MGMT promoter methylation was measured by methylation-specific PCR in 210 GIT tumors versus 90 adjacent normal tissues, a case-control style comparison intended to support early diagnosis and prognosis.

This study profiles mRNA expression of histone-modifying enzymes (HATs, HDACs, KDMs) in cultured human mesenchymal stromal cells rather than directly measuring methylation, histone marks, or chromatin state.
Meningioma DNA methylation was profiled with the Illumina 450K array in a 140-sample training/validation cohort to build a methylation-based classifier predicting recurrence-free survival.
HDAC6 was assessed only at the mRNA/protein expression level via qRT-PCR, western blot, and IHC, not as a directly measured histone modification or chromatin mark.
CRMP4 promoter methylation was quantified by bisulfite pyrosequencing in prostate biopsies across a training set and two independent validation cohorts to predict lymph node metastasis.
OPRM1 promoter DNA methylation was measured by nested MSP in leukocyte DNA from 66 men with opium use disorder versus 57 controls, a case-control design.

This prospective cohort study of smoking and synchronous colorectal cancer risk discusses CIMP and BRAF status as background but does not report direct measurement of an epigenetic marker in this analysis.

Genome-wide peripheral blood DNA methylation was measured on the 450K array in a nested case-control study of 687 incident prostate cancer cases within a prospective cohort, examining risk association.
H3K9 dimethylation, a histone modification, was measured in blood from a cohort of 15 multiple sclerosis patients and evaluated as a predictor of relapse and treatment responsiveness.

DNA methylation targets were identified using breast cancer cell-line models; the human patient cohort analysis relied on survival association with these target genes rather than methylation measured directly in patients.

Gamma-H2AX foci decay, an eligible histone modification readout, was measured in ex vivo-irradiated lymphocytes from a retrospective prostate cancer cohort to derive a prognostic marker for late radiation toxicity.
TPX2 was evaluated by mRNA expression and immunohistochemistry as a prognostic marker in renal cell carcinoma, with no epigenetic mark directly measured.
CNR1 promoter DNA methylation was directly measured in human PBMCs from 25 schizophrenia patients versus other diagnostic groups, with a rodent model used only for mechanistic confirmation.
Global blood 5-methylcytosine content was measured by ELISA-like assay in a three-group cross-sectional study of asbestos-exposed and unexposed subjects, linking a modifiable exposure to methylation.
The sperm chromatin structure assay used here measures DNA strand breakage and packaging, which per the instrument does not constitute a regulatory epigenetic marker.
This methods paper builds a physiological dysregulation index from clinical blood biochemistry biomarkers and Random Survival Forests, with no epigenetic marker involved.

CDKN2A nonpromoter methylation was measured by the Illumina 27K array in laryngeal SCC tumor samples and validated in TCGA, with combined methylation/expression status linked to locoregional recurrence.

AHRR cg05575921 methylation, a validated smoking biomarker, was measured in leukocyte DNA from 9234 Copenhagen City Heart Study participants and linked prospectively to COPD, lung cancer, and mortality.
This randomized trial of azacitidine plus the HDAC inhibitor pracinostat in MDS reports clinical response and survival outcomes but does not measure any epigenetic marker in participants.
This sequencing study of clonal evolution in myelodysplasia to secondary AML profiles somatic mutations in DNA-methylation and splicing genes, but does not measure DNA methylation itself.
This birth-cohort study of cytokine responses and allergen exposure measures immune cytokines, not any epigenetic marker; CpG here refers only to a stimulatory oligonucleotide reagent.

CIMP status, ordinarily a DNA methylation classification, is stated to have been evaluated by reverse transcriptase-PCR, leaving it unclear whether methylation or only expression was actually measured.

A 25-CpG DNA methylation aggressiveness classifier was developed from prostate cancer foci and matched lymph node metastases in 14 patients and validated in an independent cohort, linked to invasive stage.
CYP11B2 promoter methylation was measured by pyrosequencing in a 192-participant hospital-based case-control study of essential hypertension, with gene-environment interaction analysis.

In the randomized, placebo-controlled DISC trial, SFRP1 promoter DNA methylation was measured by pyrosequencing in rectal mucosal biopsies before and after resistant starch/polydextrose supplementation.
DNA methylation changes with escalating alcohol use were measured in the nucleus accumbens of rhesus macaques, an animal model with no human participants.
This is a cohort profile update for the Generation R Study describing design and available data resources rather than reporting a specific marker-outcome analysis.
HPV16 methylation was measured by next-generation sequencing and pyrosequencing in cervical CIN3 versus invasive cancer samples, distinguishing precancer from cancer for diagnostic purposes.
TOP2A, HELLS, ATAD2, and TET3 were assessed as mRNA expression prognostic markers in renal cell carcinoma; no DNA methylation, histone mark, or chromatin state was directly measured.
Salivary genome-wide DNA methylation was measured on the 450K array in Hispanic preschool children and correlated with maternal BMI to identify pathways for pediatric obesity risk stratification.

A three-CpG DNA methylation signature (MSEH) was developed from 450K profiling of 576 hepatocellular carcinoma patients across discovery, training, and multiple validation cohorts to predict recurrence.
This reads as an invited perspective/review summarizing five years of genetic and epigenetic findings in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis rather than presenting new primary data.
This exome sequencing study of follicular lymphoma identifies histone-gene somatic mutations, which are genetic alterations rather than a directly measured epigenetic mark.
ASXL1 and ASXL2 mutations were genotyped in pediatric AML patients; despite ASXL2 being an epigenetic regulator gene, the study measures DNA sequence mutations, not an epigenetic mark.

Promoter DNA methylation of ERalpha, C/EBPalpha, and OLIG2 was measured by pyrosequencing in AML patients from a phase II decitabine trial to identify biomarkers of response to hypomethylating therapy.
Biological age here is computed from 15 clinical biochemistry biomarkers via principal component analysis, not from DNA methylation or any other epigenetic clock measurement.
This multicenter survey reports clinical outcomes of myeloid sarcoma treatment without measuring any epigenetic marker.
This RCT of photobiomodulation and cryotherapy for muscle recovery measures oxidative damage and creatine kinase biomarkers, none of which is an epigenetic marker.
Placental mtDNA and CYP1A1 promoter DNA methylation were measured by bisulfite pyrosequencing in the ENVIRONAGE birth cohort and linked to maternal smoking, a modifiable exposure, and birth weight.

ATX promoter methylation was measured by bisulfite pyrosequencing in leukocytes and liver tissue of a 130-subject case-control study of biliary atresia and linked to disease progression and hepatic dysfunction.
This preclinical study of panobinostat efficacy against DIPG uses genetically engineered and xenograft mouse models, with no human participants or samples.
Hypomethylating-agent resistance was characterized in MOLM-13-derived cell lines and mouse xenograft models, with no human participants involved.

The RHCG-TCAF1 promoter methylation panel was discovered by 450K profiling of prostate tumor tissue and validated by qPCR in two independent radical prostatectomy cohorts to predict biochemical recurrence.
NDRG4 promoter and gene-body methylation were measured by MethyLight and pyrosequencing in 110 gastric cancer patients and TCGA, serving as diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers.
This immunohistochemistry study reports total H2AX protein expression in cervical squamous carcinoma rather than a specific histone modification such as phosphorylated gamma-H2AX.
Beyond miR-23b/miR-193a expression, DNA methylation at the miR-23b locus was directly measured in a cohort of HCC patients and linked to survival, so ncRNA is not the only marker measured.
LINE-1 methylation was quantified by qPCR in microdissected tumor tissue from a 164-patient stage II colon cancer cohort and shown to predict overall survival.
This is a small descriptive series of nine colorectal cancer patients examining diurnal SEPT9 methylation variation, without a defined comparison-group design.
Gamma-H2AX foci, an eligible histone modification, were measured in PBMCs in a prospective controlled trial of oral antioxidant treatment before diagnostic radiation exposure.
This is a case series of 11 patients with bithalamic gliomas describing clinical, radiologic, and methylation-clustering features without a comparison group.

Circulating methylation markers, including hypermethylated miRNAs and genes, were measured in plasma to build a predictive model for HCC diagnosis and prognosis with reported sensitivity and specificity.
LINE1 DNA methylation was measured in cord blood from two Chinese birth cohorts around a coal plant closure and linked to prenatal PAH exposure and childhood neurodevelopmental scores.
Global DNA hypomethylation (5-methyl-2'-deoxycytidine) was measured in a 209-case, 417-control study of urothelial carcinoma and linked to cadmium/lead exposure, a modifiable environmental factor.
Promoter methylation of COX2, EGR1, and SOCS3 was measured in cord blood and saliva of arsenic-exposed newborns and children, linking a modifiable environmental exposure to methylation change.
This bioinformatic reanalysis of a public GEO microarray dataset identifies differentially expressed genes for trisomy 21 amniocytes, not any epigenetic marker.
Genome-wide DNA methylation was quantified in 262 post-mortem brain samples across four regions from 41 schizophrenia patients and 47 controls, a case-control design.
This phase 2 trial of neoadjuvant temozolomide for glioblastoma reports 4-year overall survival stratified by MGMT promoter methylation status, a directly measured prognostic marker.
LINE1 and DNA repair gene (OGG1, APEX1, PARP1) methylation were measured by pyrosequencing in a cross-sectional study of 150 schoolchildren exposed to particulate matter air pollution.
This nested case-control study identifies serum proteomic peaks, including histone acetyltransferase protein peaks, for colon cancer detection, but does not measure an epigenetic modification itself.

Smoking-related DNA methylation CpGs were measured on the Illumina 450K array in two independent older-adult cohorts and linked to a frailty index, tying a modifiable exposure to a health-monitoring outcome.

MGMT promoter methylation was quantified by bisulphite-PCR pyrosequencing in 96 benzene-exposed petrochemical workers versus 100 matched controls, linking a modifiable occupational exposure to methylation.
SHOX2 and SEPT9 promoter methylation were measured in tumor tissue and plasma from biliary tract cancer patients and controls to evaluate diagnostic and prognostic biomarker performance.

DNA methylation at GSTp1, MGMT, and LINE-1 was measured by pyrosequencing in blood from Agricultural Health Study pesticide applicators and linked to high pesticide exposure events, a modifiable occupational exposure.
Genome-wide sperm DNA methylation was measured via multiple platforms including the 450K array in a controlled study of low-dose folic acid supplementation, a modifiable dietary intervention.

A 12-marker DNA methylation panel was identified by array profiling of human breast tissue and validated by digital PCR in plasma cfDNA from breast cancer patients and healthy volunteers for early detection.
DNA methylation in the COASY and SPINT1 promoter regions was measured by MS-HRM in normal, aMCI, and Alzheimer's disease subjects as a diagnostic biomarker candidate.

H3 K27M is a histone gene point mutation detected by sequencing and mutant-specific immunostaining in paediatric gangliogliomas, which is a genetic alteration rather than a directly measured histone modification.
GSK3beta promoter methylation was assessed by MS-PCR per the methods, but the results section reports only the rs334558 polymorphism and expression findings, leaving the methylation results unclear.
Epigenome-wide DNA methylation was measured on the 450K array in a longitudinal cohort of 646 subjects and linked to specific PM2.5 chemical species, a modifiable environmental exposure.
This analysis of romidepsin response by line of therapy in T-cell lymphoma reports clinical outcomes only, with no epigenetic marker measured despite romidepsin being an HDAC inhibitor.
Loss and gain of methylation at the 11p15.5 imprinted region were directly measured for molecular diagnosis in a retrospective cohort of 27 Chinese Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome patients.
CpG island methylation was quantified by MS-MLPA in a 50-patient training cohort and validated in 203 adrenocortical cancer patients as an independent prognostic factor.
A DNA methylation-derived neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio index was built from methylation data across bladder, head and neck, ovarian, and breast cancer case-control studies and linked to survival.
This trio-based exome sequencing study identifies de novo ZNF148 truncating mutations causing an intellectual disability syndrome, a genetic finding rather than a measured epigenetic mark.
DNA methylation was combined with sequencing and RNA data to define a BRCA-deficient TNBC subtype in MDACC, TCGA, and METABRIC cohorts, linked to chemosensitivity and survival outcomes.
Circulating histone-MPO complexes were measured as a NET biomarker in myeloproliferative neoplasm patients, which per the instrument is a protein assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
Tumor LINE-1 methylation was measured by MethyLight assay in 40 advanced-stage colorectal cancer patients and correlated with survival and response to FOLFOX chemotherapy.

OSMR and SFRP1 promoter methylation in cell-free DNA was measured by qPCR in a cohort of 114 colorectal cancer patients, 56 healthy subjects, and 22 adenoma patients for diagnostic and prognostic value.
